turns.question: What share of the orders placed in September 2026 were returned?
turns.answer: The return rate for orders placed from 1 to 30 September 2026 was 0.0167 (about 1.67 % of orders returned, returns counted on the day the order was placed). Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
